goal: Align the real pipeline detail header, status metadata, primary actions, and existing route tabs with the approved prototype without changing API, store, router, or permission contracts.
non_goals: Do not implement the step overview, log presentation, changed-files/config/errors/debug page bodies, or release outcome panel owned by tasks 3.2 and 3.3.
Do not modify router, API, store, authentication, repository permission calculation, backend, persistence, dependencies, or the approved prototype.
Do not add a fake more menu, a second tab system, prototype fixtures, or a generic page-header abstraction without a second equivalent consumer.
expected_evidence: Focused red/green component tests for metadata hierarchy, translated status, action state, permissions, API/router intent, deploy target, and tabs.
Full frontend Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff output.
Targeted desktop and 390px browser evidence for push and read-only pipeline detail states.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent A2/A3 spec and quality reviews.
unsafe_assumptions: Prototype action availability never overrides real pipeline state or repository push permission.
A successful pipeline may lack a release mapping and must retain the existing deploy popup fallback.
The prototype log query tab is not a production route contract yet.
Zero changed-files or error counts do not make the existing read-only routes unreachable.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation requires changes outside the four allowed files or invents a router, API, store, permission, or component-boundary contract.
